resumen: Reserva: lunes 21 de septiembre a las 8:30, Dra. Montse Roca, Arenal Sur

eventos.texto: Good evening, Clínica Arenal, you're through to reception. How can I help you today?
Hi, I'm at Calle de Madrid 54 in Getafe. I'd like the earliest GP appointment at whichever clinic is closest.
Entiende cuándo la quiere: lo antes posible
Could I take your full name, and either your DNI or NIE, or the phone number on your file?
Mario Garcia Lopez, my DNI is 39••••38.
Ficha encontrada: Mario G. (por DNI y nombre)
Ofrece el lunes 21 de septiembre a las 8:30 con la Dra. Montse Roca en Arenal Sur
Thank you, Mario, I have your record here. The earliest I have in the morning is Monday the 21st of September at 8:30 am with Dra. Montse Roca at Arenal Sur. Shall I book that for you?
Reserva · lunes 21 de septiembre, 8:30 · Dra. Montse Roca · Arenal Sur
That's booked: Monday the 21st of September at 8:30 am with Dra. Montse Roca at Arenal Sur. Is there anything else I can help with?
Thank you for calling. Take care, goodbye.
